name: Bathyal-Serac
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past an ancient meteor crater, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Debris from the starship crash site (colony ship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
